name: Client report check log
summary: Before a batch of client reports is released, the reporting lead gets a log, report by report, of household membership, periods, totals against the custodian statements, fee figures and missing sections, with every difference marked for correction. Nothing is released or sent.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work, written into a method with fixed inputs, numbered rules, stop conditions and a worked example.
